final_answer:
No, it is not possible to tile an 8x8 chessboard with 2x1 dominoes if two opposite corners are removed. Here's why:

A standard chessboard has 64 squares, alternating between two colors (let's say black and white). When two opposite corners are removed, both of these squares are the same color (since opposite corners on a chessboard are always the same color). This leaves 32 squares of one color and 30 of the other.

Each 2x1 domino always covers one square of each color. To fully tile the board, the number of squares of each color must be equal. However, with the removal of two opposite corners, this balance is disrupted. Since there are unequal numbers of the two colors, it is impossible to cover the remaining squares with dominoes without leaving some uncovered or overlapping.

Thus, tiling the modified board with 2x1 dominoes is not possible.
